meta.title: VR overlay for SteamVR and OpenXR
meta.description: Mirror windows, read notifications and control media without taking off your headset.

hero.eyebrow: VR overlay for SteamVR and OpenXR
hero.title: Your desktop, right beside you in VR
hero.body: Mirror windows, read notifications and control media without taking off your headset.
hero.scene_label: nyaw's dashboard, a mirrored window, quick settings and the wrist watch floating in VR

tour.title: Everything within reach
tour.dashboard_body: Press the shortcut on the left controller twice to open it. Start mirroring, play media and change settings from one bar.
tour.mirroring_body: Pick a screen or window from the launcher to display it above the dashboard. Point the laser and press to use it like a mouse.
tour.quick_settings_body: Press the clock on the dashboard to open quick settings and adjust common settings on the spot.
tour.wrist_body: Glance at your wrist to check the time. New notifications appear at the edge of your view and on your wrist.

features.title: Features
features.mirroring_body: Display any screen or window in VR and use it with the laser.
features.notifications_body: Windows notifications appear at the edge of your view and on your wrist.
features.media_body: See what's playing and skip tracks from the dashboard.
features.keyboard_body: Type into mirrored apps with a keyboard in front of you.
features.hands_body: Use your hands as well as your controllers.
features.runtimes_body: Runs on SteamVR or an OpenXR runtime, and starts together with SteamVR.
features.appearance_body: Choose a light or dark theme and an accent colour for buttons and other elements.
features.guides_body: A short tutorial and controller guides walk you through every control.
features.body: Everything nyaw brings into VR, from mirrored windows to notifications on your wrist.

cta.title: Get nyaw
cta.body: Free and open source. Runs on Windows 10 and 11.

download.title: Download nyaw
download.body: Install nyaw on your Windows PC and start it with SteamVR or an OpenXR runtime.
download.unavailable: Couldn't check the latest version. Get it from GitHub Releases
download.install_setup: Follow the setup to choose your hand, theme and watch face.
download.updates: Check for and install updates from Settings.
download.stable_body: The tested version. Choose this one if you're not sure.
download.nightly_body: Builds with features that haven't been released yet. They may be unstable.
download.nightly_none: No nightly build is newer than the stable version
